name: Old Haunt
_notes: Transcribed from sheet DU3248 (Lv I-IX), Setup cards (Secret 220-224), VP Eclipse Point DV2539, AI CV1793-CV1803 + DV2540-DV2549, Merciless Sun DV2569.
BP DECK IS A PLACEHOLDER (copied from Sun Descendant) — the Pitiless / Old Haunt BP cards were not provided.
Old Wounds: AI I/II = Pitiless cards + new cards, AI III = new cards. "Pitiless" text applies to the Old Haunt. BP "do not escalate" rules ignored.
Embrace Zone = Manhattan distance <= 3 from the statue, Denial Zone = <= 6 (read from the card diagrams).
Sun Attacks: shading as Sun Descendant (a tile/Titan on the light side of the space). VP (Eclipse Point) is always shaded unless Magnifying Glass.
Pitiless Sun: a Titan on the VP is not treated as adjacent (VP is not a space) — interpretation.

traits: Make the Sun Move and the Earth Stand Still

traits.Son of Dusk: When you setup a battle with the Old Haunt in the Mnestis Theatre, use the Battle Setup cards you've found in the Envelope Y.
traits.Pitiless Sun: If you start the Primordial Round or your Titan turn adjacent to the Old Haunt, you are incinerated.
traits.God Among Men: The Old Haunt performs his Round after 2 Titan turns. Then the other 2 Titans go, then the Old Haunt, then the players can rearrange their playing order. At the start of each Old Haunt's Round, perform Merciless Sun.
traits.Glass it All: If you were on a Shaded space during any Sun Attack, destroy the Terrain tile that shaded that space, even if Indestructible.
traits.Gods Don't Look Back: Titans attacking from the Blindspot gain additional +1 Precision (on top of the regular bonus).
traits.End of Hope: End of Primordial Round: Perform Signature.
traits.Ruthless: Remove all positive Trauma cards from the Trauma decks (except Obols).
traits.Magnifying Glass: VP becomes unshaded. After a Titan fails a Climb test, perform Signature against that Titan.
traits.Blinding Shine: The Old Haunt cannot be Wounded from the front.
traits.Beginning of the End: End of Primordial Round: Before End of Hope, draw and perform another AI card.
traits.Unworthy Will Die: At the end of the Primordial Round, the Old Haunt destroys the closest Irem Tower.
traits.Cannot Hide From the Sun: Titan with the Priority Target token cannot be shaded in any way.
traits.God Taken Law: When an Irem Tower is destroyed, each Titan adjacent to it is dealt X DANGER, where X is the number of Towers already removed.
traits.Make the Sun Move and the Earth Stand St: At the end of the Primordial Round, the Old Haunt appears at the closest Sun Circle.
traits.Spontaneous Supernova: When the Old Haunt appears at a Sun Circle, all unshaded Titans are incinerated and destroy any Terrain tile that shaded a Titan, even if indestructible.
